subject: Duplicate binding error when renaming tab

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Duplicate binding error when renaming tab
parts:
I have a tabSet generator that's generated UI.

When I replace the tabSet generator (by re-running the UI) and one of the tabs IDs changes, I get a duplicate binding error for an output contained in the replacement tab.

This shouldn't happen because the old tab is going away as part of the update.

The effect of this is that the tab set no longer operates correctly - it doesn't supply updated input values for the tab bar itself.

-Alex

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Re: Duplicate binding error when renaming tab
parts:
Looks like the first visit to the duplicated htmloutput is in a recursed call to bindouputs, the second is from the original call:

attached image showing the first.

When rebinding outputs, ALL outputs from the scope are considered, even if nested in other htmloutputs.

Bindoutput does this test:

      if (this.$values[id] !== undefined)
        binding.onValueChange(this.$values[id]);

Which means child htmloutputs of the current binding are bound now, even though they are still in the queue for binding from the original call.

When the original call considers them, they already appear to be bound, which causes a fault, and stops consideration of further bindings, and does not send the updated inputs back to the server.

-Alex
